info.name: EVE Swagger Interface Alliance Mail API

params.name: character_id
params.description: An EVE character ID

params.name: datasource
params.description: The server name you would like data from

params.name: labels
params.description: Fetch only mails that match one or more of the given labels

params.name: last_mail_id
params.description: List only mail with an ID lower than the given ID, if present

params.name: token
params.description: Access token to use if unable to set a header

items.docs:
Return the 50 most recent mail headers belonging to the character that match the query criteria. Queries can be filtered by label, and last_mail_id can be used to paginate backwards

---
Alternate route: `/dev/characters/{character_id}/mail/`

Alternate route: `/legacy/characters/{character_id}/mail/`

Alternate route: `/v1/characters/{character_id}/mail/`

---
This route is cached for up to 30 seconds
